accessKey.title: Access Key
accessKey.description: The access key obtained from AWS.

secretKey.title: Secret Key
secretKey.description: The secret key obtained from AWS.

sourceLanguage.title: Source Language
sourceLanguage.description: The source language of the translating text.

targetLanguage.title: Target Language
targetLanguage.description: The target language of the translating text.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.title: Default Credentials Provider
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the Translate client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider or to expect static credentials to be passed in.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.title: Profile Credentials Provider
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the Translate client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

useSessionCredentials.title: Session Credentials
useSessionCredentials.description: Set whether the Translate client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in situation in which the user needs to assume a IAM role for doing operations in Translate.

profileCredentialsName.title: Profile Credentials Name
profileCredentialsName.description: If using a profile credentials provider this parameter sets the profile name.

sessionToken.title: Session Token
sessionToken.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume a IAM role.
